_notes: Argonaut portraits AH0147-AH0155 + generic AH0623-AH0626 (chosen skill).
Mnestis setup (rulebook p.70): any portrait; assign 2 unlocked Mnemos — one at Level 2 (7 nodes: Lv1+Lv2 abilities) and one at Level 1 (3 nodes).
Skills: Courage, Wisdom, Will, Endurance, Cunning, Fury. Value = portrait skill + 1 per Mnemos listing that skill. Skill test: d10 + skill >= target (natural 10 success, natural 1 fail).
Mnemos icons: ⟳ = exhaust this Mnemos card, X = discard it, Ψ = gain +1 Fate, D3+ = Danger gate, [R] = reaction (◆!).

2026-10-20: Cycle IV Mnemos (DG2054-DG2061) and Fated Mnemos (DF2070-DF2078), Cycle V Mnemos (EG2640-EG2647) and Fated Mnemos (EF2648-EF2656) added. gateKind 'pain'/'despair' = gate counts Pain/Despair tokens instead of DANGER.
